visualQaChecklist: Open NetSuite and confirm only one Demo launcher is visible.
Drag launcher near the top right and confirm it snaps to top right.
Drag launcher near the middle right and confirm it snaps to middle right.
Drag launcher near the bottom right and confirm it snaps to bottom right.
Refresh NetSuite and confirm the selected position persists.
Press ArrowUp, ArrowDown, and Home while launcher is focused to verify keyboard movement/reset.
Click launcher and confirm drawer opens exactly as before.
Right-click launcher to reset to the default middle-right position.

surgicalArchitecturePlan.name: Build Results Tab Reset
surgicalArchitecturePlan.goal: Make Review earn its place by becoming Build Handoff before generated names and Build Results after import.

surgicalArchitecturePlan.name: Consultant-Safe Export Language
surgicalArchitecturePlan.goal: Shield visible export labels from internal implementation language while preserving schema compatibility.
surgicalArchitecturePlan.reason: Harness can prove labels and export contracts unless visible layout changes.

surgicalArchitecturePlan.name: Value Coach Intelligence Upgrade
surgicalArchitecturePlan.goal: Reduce repetition and add competitor/FUD prep using named competitor or clearly labeled inferred alternatives.
surgicalArchitecturePlan.reason: ROI / Competitive first viewport changes and needs consultant readability feedback.

surgicalArchitecturePlan.name: Run Story Engine V2
surgicalArchitecturePlan.goal: Replace similar chips with differentiated story stages tied to pain, proof, metric, objection, and next decision.

surgicalArchitecturePlan.name: Final Names Navigation Layer
surgicalArchitecturePlan.goal: Use imported final generated NetSuite record names and links throughout Build Results and Run pivots.
surgicalArchitecturePlan.reason: Post-build navigation is a core live consultant workflow.

surgicalArchitecturePlan.name: Governed Invocation Readiness
surgicalArchitecturePlan.goal: Define exact safety gates before any future build-engine invocation from the drawer.
surgicalArchitecturePlan.reason: Contract and trace gate only; no visible write action enabled.

surgicalArchitecturePlan.name: Preview-Only Invocation Bridge
surgicalArchitecturePlan.goal: Prepare preview-only invocation artifacts without submit, queue, script invocation, or write.
surgicalArchitecturePlan.reason: Operator/harness smoke before consultant UI exposure.

surgicalArchitecturePlan.name: Sandbox Build Invocation With Type-To-Confirm
surgicalArchitecturePlan.goal: Enable first governed sandbox build invocation behind confirmation and operator approval.
surgicalArchitecturePlan.reason: This is the first visible step toward real system writes.

surgicalArchitecturePlan.name: Real Build Result Import
surgicalArchitecturePlan.goal: Import real generated names from a completed sandbox build and prove the drawer uses them.
surgicalArchitecturePlan.reason: Consultant must confirm final names and navigation are useful.

surgicalArchitecturePlan.name: First Write Pilot Scorecard
surgicalArchitecturePlan.goal: Grade safety, usability, rollback, trace, and generated-name reliability before broader pilot.
